title: A Study of the Potential Pharmacokinetic Interaction Between Quinidine Sulfate and Nalbuphine Extended-Release Tablets (NAL ER) in Healthy Participants
official: A Phase 1, Open-Label, Fixed-Sequence, Drug-Drug Interaction Study to Evaluate the Effect of Multiple Doses of Quinidine Sulfate, a P-glycoprotein (P-gp) Inhibitor, on the Pharmacokinetics of Nalbuphine Extended-Release Tablets in Healthy Adult Subjects
summary: The primary purpose of this study is to evaluate the effect of quinidine sulfate on the pharmacokinetics (PK) of NAL ER in healthy participants.
criteria:
Key Inclusion Criteria:

* Body mass index (BMI) ≥ 18.0 and ≤ 30.0 kilogram per meter square (kg/m\^2) at screening.
* Medically healthy with no clinically significant medical history, physical examination, laboratory profiles, vital signs or electrocardiograms (ECGs), as deemed by the principal investigator (PI) or designee.

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of any diagnosed moderate or severe substance use disorder, other than tobacco use disorder, or a history of or current regular excessive consumption of alcohol.
* Positive urine drug or alcohol results.
* Smoker who has smoked or used nicotine containing products within the last 3 months.
* Clinically significant hypokalemia or hypomagnesemia at the screening visit.
* History of prolonged QT syndrome.
* Abnormal liver tests at screening.
* Positive results at screening for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) or hepatitis C virus (HCV).
* Abnormal estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR).

Note: Other inclusion/exclusion criteria mentioned in the protocol may apply.
